title: Amazon.com

thesis: This episode argues that Amazon is a dominant, highly valued public company with a brilliant ad business, successful defense against competitors like Apple and Google, and a strong focus on the customer. It highlights Amazon's profitability, market cap growth, and strategic acquisitions, while also noting its early failed experiments and tax nexus challenges.
